sentences.text:
01. By this petition preferred under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, the petitioner has prayed for the following reliefs:
"(I) To direct the respondent no. 2 and 3 for the commencement and expeditious completion of M.R. 5 Road (Chhota Bangarda Road) construction as per the approved Master Plan, with a reasonable timeline to be fixed by this Hon'ble Court,
(II) Direction to the respondent no. 2 to conduct inspections and close down unlicensed illegal slaughter establishments violating municipal regulations without further delay.
(III) Direction to the Municipal Corporation and District Administration to ensure compliance with food safety standards, public health requirements, and traffic safety norms in the area.
(IV) Direction to the Respondent No.1 to file a detailed status report regarding the reasons for non-completion of M.R. 5 Road, inter-departmental issues, and a proposed timeline for completion.

02. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the respondents are duty bound to complete the construction of MR-5 Road (Chhota Bangarda Road) which is about 100 feet only.
It is submitted that the respondents are not doing the same without any rhyme or reason.
A prayer has been made for issuance of appropriate directions in that regard.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-IND:4818 2 WP-5479-2026 03.

Learned counsel for the respondents/State submits that the dispute is inter se the Municipal Corporation and the Indore Development Authority and it is for them to take appropriate action in the matter.

04. Thus, in the available facts of the case, it is directed that in respect of the grievance as regards non-construction of the road in question, the petitioner may prefer a detailed representation before respondents No.2 and 3.

In case such a representation is preferred by the petitioner, then appropriate action thereupon shall be taken and a decision shall be arrived at as to which authority is the competent authority to make construction of the road.
Let the same be done within a period of two months from the date of filing of the representation by the petitioner.
As per the decision to be taken by respondents No.2 and 3, construction of the road shall be commenced forthwith and completed as expeditiously as possible.
05. In respect of the other reliefs as claimed for by the petitioner, it is observed that he has already approached the respondents in respect of the same.

The respondents / competent authority are hence directed to advert to the complaint of the petitioner and to take appropriate action thereupon as may be deemed fit by affording due opportunity of hearing to the concerned parties as expeditiously as possible.
06. With the aforesaid directions, the petition stands disposed off.
